lede: The Planning and Zoning Commission meets Monday, November 2 for a rescheduled special session with one item: a lot-line vacation that would merge two parcels at 510 W Columbia/129 N Townsend into a single 5,625-square-foot lot in West Telluride — worth watching if you care about how land gets consolidated in town. The rest of the week's government calendar is mostly unposted agendas, while the community side is wall-to-wall Halloween, capped by Mountainfilm for Locals running Monday and Tuesday.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on merging two West Telluride lots into one parcel.
